d.d: Acronym of electronic toll collection, a system to eliminate delays on toll roads by collecting them electronically.

To cut into a surface with an acid or other corrosive substance in order to make a pattern. Best known as a technique for creating printing plates, but also used for decoration on metal, and, in modern industry, to make circuit boards.

d.x: The memory of 9/11 is etched into my mind.

d.d: Cut or dug into the surface as by etching.
Toned and with a well-defined musculature.
